mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO safety_park_employee_power_info ( EMPLOYEE_CODE, FACTORY_ID, factory_name, POWER_BEGIN_TIME, POWER_END_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, IS_DELETE, down_mark, REMARK ) VALUES
( #{ll.employeeCode}, #{ll.factoryId}, #{ll.factoryName}, #{ll.powerBeginTime}, #{ll.powerEndTime}, NOW(), NOW(), #{ll.isDelete}, #{ll.downMark}, #{ll.remark} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IS_DELETE = VALUES(IS_DELETE), POWER_BEGIN_TIME = VALUES(POWER_BEGIN_TIME), POWER_END_TIME = VALUES(POWER_END_TIME), UPDATE_TIME = NOW(), factory_name = VALUES(factory_name), down_mark = VALUES(down_mark)

INSERT INTO safety.safety_park_employee_power_info_temp ( EMPLOYEE_CODE, FACTORY_ID, factory_name, POWER_BEGIN_TIME, POWER_END_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, IS_DELETE, down_mark, REMARK ) VALUES
( #{ll.employeeCode}, #{ll.factoryId}, #{ll.factoryName}, #{ll.powerBeginTime}, #{ll.powerEndTime}, NOW(), NOW(), #{ll.isDelete}, #{ll.downMark}, #{ll.remark} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE IS_DELETE = VALUES(IS_DELETE), POWER_BEGIN_TIME = VALUES(POWER_BEGIN_TIME), POWER_END_TIME = VALUES(POWER_END_TIME), UPDATE_TIME = NOW(), factory_name = VALUES(factory_name), down_mark = VALUES(down_mark)
mapper.select: select pi.id, pi.EMPLOYEE_CODE, pi.FACTORY_ID, pi.POWER_BEGIN_TIME, pi.POWER_END_TIME, pi.REMARK, pi.CREATE_TIME, pi.UPDATE_TIME, pi.IS_DELETE, m.emp_name as employee_name, pi.down_mark from safety_park_employee_power_info pi left join safety_employee_message m on pi.EMPLOYEE_CODE = m.emp_no and m.status = 'NORMAL' where pi.IS_DELETE = '0' and pi.EMPLOYEE_CODE = #{empNo} order by pi.POWER_END_TIME
